description: MainActivity.java for an Android app that uses MediaCodec and MediaExtractor to decode and render video frames onto a TextureView, with playback controlled via TimeAnimator.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that handles video playback using MediaCodec and MediaExtractor, rendering frames on a TextureView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and finds views.

methods.description: Stops the animator and releases media resources.
